_doc: Golden prompts for ask-assist. Each case is one conversation: every turn but the last is run first (in `history_mode`, default `mode`) to build history; `expect` is the reply type (or list of acceptable types) for the LAST turn. `l1` is the first_language code. Add a case for every real failure.
